senses.en_definition: A masculine given name of Hebrew origin.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi orang, lazimnya nama lelaki, yang berasal daripada bahasa Ibrani.

etymology.historical_story: Nathan comes from a Hebrew name meaning “he gave.” Biblical tradition includes a prophet called Nathan associated with King David. The name subsequently became established in several languages, including English and French. This history explains an international personal name; it does not justify splitting its ending into the productive Malay suffix -an.
